Three of the five open PRs can go to `main` now. Two need work first.

**Ready to merge:**
- **#104** — Search or ask Moneo from the header palette. Clean against `main` and against the other PRs.
- **#103** — Show AI token usage per model in Settings. Clean against `main`, and it only conflicts with #107.
- **#106** — Know the owner's own accounts and keep transfers out of cashflow. Clean against `main`, but see the migration note below.

**Not ready:**
- **#105** — Propose loans from chat. It adds migration `202610260001_iou_proposals.sql`, which has the same version prefix as #106's `202610260001_own_accounts.sql`. Supabase identifies migrations by that prefix, so one of them has to be renumbered before either lands. #105 also conflicts with #107 in `app/page.tsx`. Once renumbered it can merge after #107 is sorted out.
- **#107** — Overview redesign. It's large (43 files, +861/−349) and conflicts with #103 in `components/chart.tsx` and with #105 in `app/page.tsx`. It should go in after #103, and then #105 can be rebased onto it.

**Suggested order:** #104, #103, #106 now. Then rebase #107 onto the new `main` and merge it. Then renumber #105's migration, rebase it, and merge.

I checked mergeability and conflicts with git merge-tree, and GitHub reports green checks on all five. I didn't run the test suite on any branch, so "can be merged" means no conflicts and passing CI, not a local test run. I haven't merged anything.
